howto.what: 当被问到时，Claude 会说明：每次读取、编辑和运行命令都会被压缩成记录，在会话结束时总结；相关记录会自动注入未来对话，留存项目背景。
howto.when: 当用户问“how does claude-mem work?”或“what is this thing doing?”时触发。

say.note: 会解释记录捕获、注入时机和数据存放位置。
会说明数据保存在本机 ~/.claude-mem 中。

say.text: 怎么把整个代码库一次性装进记忆？

howto.what_en: Claude explains that every read, edit, and command execution is compressed into an observation, summarized at session end, and relevant ones are auto-injected into future prompts for context.
howto.when_en: When the user asks “how does claude-mem work?” or “what is this thing doing?”.

say_en.note: Explains observation capture, injection timing, and where data lives.
Data stays in ~/.claude-mem on this machine.

say_en.text: How do I load the whole codebase into memory at once?
